the intervention group (supplementation with a high quality concentrates) had greater growth rates and higher profitability compared to the control group (traditional feeding) for crossbred bulls raised in smallholder systems in East Java.
feeding a high quality concentrate to bulls in the intervention system increased their growth and resulted in greater farmer profits.
the feeding of concentrate to crossbred bulls in smallholder fattener operations in Indonesia resulted in greater profits than feeding of roughage alone.

the improvement of smallholder fattened bull production in Indonesia.
the economic benefits of feeding high quality concentrate to smallholder farmers.
improving the productivity and profitability of smallholder beef cattle fattening systems in Indonesia by providing a simple, low-cost feeding intervention to farmers.

concentrate supplementation for crossbred bull fattening in smallholder systems in Indonesia can increase farmer profits, but at the expense of higher feed costs.
feeding high quality concentrate to crossbred bulls in smallholder fattling operations can increase farmer profit.
feeding concentrate supplementation to crossbred bulls in East Java can increase the profitability of smallholder farmers.

the use of high-quality concentrate in smallholder cattle fattening operations in Indonesia can improve the performance of crossbred bulls and increase the profitability of farmers.

farmers should consider feeding high-quality concentrate to bulls to increase the profitability of their fattening operation.
